author: Inside Edition
description: Jon Stewart dropped a bombshell on "The Daily Show," revealing that he is mentioned in the latest document dump from the Epstein files. The stunned host said his name appeared in an email sent from a Hollywood producer to Jeffrey Epstein suggesting Stewart as the host for a potential TV special on Woody Allen. The show never happened and Stewart says he never met Epstein. More than three million documents in the Epstein files were released.
title: Jon Stewart Reveals He Is Mentioned In Epstein Files

author: Inside Edition
description: Will Bad Bunny make a political statement during the Super Bowl halftime show like he did at the Grammy Awards? "This platform is used to unite people and to be able to bring people together with their creativity," NFL Commissioner Roger Goodell said. "I think Bad Bunny understands that and I think he'll have a great performance." Officials announced ICE agents will not be at the Super Bowl. Alison Hall attended opening night with Inside Edition Special Super Bowl Correspondent Kylan Darnell.
title: Will Bad Bunny Make A Political Statement At Super Bowl Halftime Show?

author: Inside Edition
description: One woman closely watched the trial of former IRS agent Brendan Banfield, who was just convicted of killing his wife Christine. Flight attendant Meredith Sanders had a particular interest in the trial's outcome, because she says she was close friends with the murder victim. Sanders says she met Christine Banfield at a local dog park in Virginia and they bonded over their pet huskies. Sanders spoke with Inside Edition.
title: Friend Of Christine Banfield Speaks Out

author: Inside Edition
description: New details have emerged about the abduction of Savannah Guthrie's mother. Police found a trail of blood on Nancy Guthrie's driveway and signs of forced entry and a struggle inside her million-dollar home in Tucson, according to published reports. Inside Edition spoke with Pima County Sheriff Chris Nanos. Police are appealing for Ring camera video from neighbors. Authorities say there have been no ransom demands.
title: Police Say They Found 'Trail Of Blood' On Nancy Guthrie's Driveway

author: Inside Edition
description: There is an outpouring of love and support for Savannah Guthrie and a call for anyone who knows what happened to her mother to come forward. All three network morning shows led with the heartbreaking story. Mika Brzezinski fought back tears on Morning Joe. Guthrie's colleagues are responding to her Instagram post asking everyone to "please pray." Guthrie's close bond with her mother Nancy was evident during her many "TODAY Show" appearances.
title: Savannah Guthrie Gets Outpouring Of Support Amid Mother's Disappearance

author: Inside Edition
description: The ex-husband of former first lady Jill Biden has been charged with killing his wife, Linda Stevenson. Her body was found in her living room on December 28th. Police say they found evidence of foul play, and Stevenson's husband, William, has been charged with first-degree murder. Police won't say how she was killed. Inside Edition spoke to William Stevenson in 2020 when Joe Biden was running for president against Donald Trump. The New Castle County Superior Court has not yet disclosed whether or how Stevenson has pleaded to the charges.
title: Jill Biden's Ex-Husband Charged With Murder Of His Wife

author: Inside Edition
description: A sibling duo is gearing up for the 2026 Winter Olympics to represent Greenland in the biathlon. Since the island nation has been thrust into the international spotlight, Ukaleq and Sondre Slettemark say they're looking forward to showcasing their abilities. While the two have criticized remarks about Greenland becoming part of the United States, they say they're focused on their performance in Italy. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Brother And Sister From Greenland To Compete In Winter Olympics Biathlon

author: Inside Edition
description: Police are investigating the death of a Northern Arizona University student after a rush event at a fraternity. Flagstaff Police say they found the 18-year-old male unresponsive, and despite performing life-saving measures, he could not be revived. Investigators say the deceased attended a party the previous night as a pledge at the Delta Tau Delta fraternity off campus. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: 18-Year-Old Northern Arizona University Student Dies After Fraternity Rush Party

author: Inside Edition
description: In an Inside Edition exclusive, Mark Thomas spoke out about taking down another passenger who breached airport security in Atlanta, triggering a major alert.
title: Passenger Takes Down Man Who Breached Airport Security #shorts

author: Inside Edition
description: Shelly Murphy prepared large hoagies for each of her seven relatives on their 5-hour flight from Salt Lake City to Boston. The 71-year-old grandmother spread the rolls out across the tray tables and piled on cheese, pickles and onions. She handed a sandwich to everyone in the family, husband, kids, and in-laws. Murphy's culinary creativity has since gone viral and social media can't believe it.
title: Woman Making Sandwiches For Family On Plane Goes Viral

title: Meet Inside Edition's Super Bowl Correspondent Kylan Darnell #shorts
